entities.name: Ham1-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 199-aa query sequence has Ham1p_like domain (PF01725.22), positions 11–196.
81.7% identity and 96% query coverage to reviewed Caulobacter vibrioides dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase Q9ABS4 (E=1.09e-108).
Close homologs are Mg2+-dependent nucleoside triphosphate pyrophosphatases, preferring XTP, dITP, and ITP; likely nucleotide-pool sanitizing enzyme.

entities.name: dITP/XTP triphosphate hydrolysis
observations: Homolog-catalyzed reactions include XTP + H2O → XMP + diphosphate, dITP + H2O → dIMP + diphosphate, and ITP + H2O → IMP + diphosphate; exact substrate preference for query is inferred from homology.

entities.name: Purine nucleotide pool sanitization
observations: Likely biological process: catabolism of noncanonical purine triphosphates, reducing their incorporation into DNA/RNA and associated lesions; this role is stated for the close homolog and inferred for query.
